## Rights and disputed claims

US PD (pre-1930 publication, 95-year rule); UK PD since 2018. Quote ONLY the 1909 edition — "777 Revised" (Neptune Press, 1955) adds Crowley’s annotations and revised columns and is NOT PD in the US (URAA-restored UK work, 95-year term to 2051): cite-only.

Keep the 1909 and 1955 editions distinct: quote 1909, cite 1955. The printed tables also carry "bis" rows (31 bis, 32 bis).

2. Separate bibliographic presence, a checked passage, a modern adaptation and a genuinely implemented calculation. Follow existing siteMapping only where the tool actually computes the stated quantity.
